packs.name: solar-system
packs.description: Solar System v1: Sun, planets, Moon, Pluto and the system barycenters. Mars to Pluto are placed at their system barycenters, flagged approximate (ADR-0008). Ephemeris DE440 (de440s.bsp), radii and IAU rotation elements from pck00011.tpc, GM from gm_de440.tpc, leap seconds and the TDB - TT model from naif0012.tls. Stars: the Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (CDS V/50). Saturn's rings: radii from the IAU WGPSN Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, optical depths from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node (Tier 2).

packs.name: solar-system-moons
packs.description: Solar System with the major moons, 2000 to 2100 (optional, built locally: P6-01, NFR-07). The v1 bodies with the planet centers from the JPL satellite ephemerides, and 21 major moons. Planets, Sun and Moon from DE440 (de440s.bsp); each satellite system (moons and planet center relative to the system barycenter) from its satellite kernel (mar099, jup365, sat441, ura184_part-3, nep097, plu060); records copied bit for bit. Radii and IAU rotation elements from pck00011.tpc, GM from gm_de440.tpc, leap seconds and the TDB - TT model from naif0012.tls. Stars: the Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (CDS V/50). Saturn's rings: radii from the IAU WGPSN Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, optical depths from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node (Tier 2).
